title: Reading Drill — A Small Exhibit About Bread
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Small Exhibit About Bread
passages.body:
**A** A food museum wanted to explain the difference between ingredients and methods. It placed three kinds of flour in sealed jars and used pictures to show later stages.

**B** The exhibit originally contained a long timeline, but visitors mostly asked practical questions. An educator replaced part of it with an illustrated sequence showing how dough changes when left to rise.

**C** On weekends a presenter brought an actual dough sample. For visitors who could not attend, the exhibit included a short video with the same explanation.

questions.explanation: It placed three kinds of flour in sealed jars and used pictures to show later stages.
